title: query/keys: inclusive retirement second like check?
description: Question for Mark. vouch-ey47.22 made check accept a record dated in its key's retirement second (inclusive, as OpenSSH valid-before). query --at (git-vouch cmd_query, when < key.retired) and keys (now < key.retired) still treat the retirement second as invalid, and tests/test_query.py pins that ('retired is exclusive'). git-vouch-trqp reads validity from query --at, so for T == retired check/OpenSSH say valid while query/bridge say invalid (fails closed). Options: (a) make query/keys inclusive (when <= key.retired) and update DESIGN and test_query; (b) keep query strict and leave the documented split as DESIGN now states it. Needs the core and docs locks.
